title: A computational model of circRNA-associated diseases based on a graph neural network: prediction and case studies for follow-up experimental validation.
summary: CircDA graph-based predictions were followed by RT-qPCR testing of ten predicted HCC-related circRNAs; five showed significant differential expression, supporting specific predicted associations with small experimental samples. AI role: CircDA graph neural network. The article appeared in Bmc Biology.
